title: keepalive
description: Periodic heartbeat sent by the plugin to keep WebSocket connections alive and report bot state

main_thread_last_tick_utc_ms.description: When Unity's main thread last ticked, as Unix time in milliseconds. 0 when it has not ticked yet, early in startup

main_thread_gap_ms.description: Milliseconds since that tick, measured as the keepalive is sent. A large gap means the game is hung even though the socket is alive. -1 when there is no tick yet

current_env.description: Bot's actual current environment from Photon room properties

current_track.description: Bot's actual current track from Photon room properties

current_race.description: Bot's actual current race from Photon room properties

is_host.description: Whether this bot is the Photon master client

is_open.description: Whether the room is open for joining

workshop_id.description: Steam Workshop ID of the race being flown, else of its track, read off the room's content (ManagedID). Absent when there is none, as for Liftoff's own tracks
